chapter.verse: Khangham papite khauh cih lua kei inla, pa bangin dinpih hanthawn in. Tua mah bangin tangvalte sanggam pasal bangin,
khangham nupite nu bangin leh nungakte sanggam numei bangin lungsim siangtak tawh dinpih hanthawn in.
Meigong numei, a meigong taktakte thudonin huh in.

Ahih hangin meigong numei khat in ta ahi-a tu ahi zongin a neih leh tua tuletate in amau' innkuan sungah biakna lungsim lahkhiat ding leh a nute a pite a etkik ding uh hong thei masa phot uh hen. Banghanghiam cihleh hih thu pen Pasian' muhna ah a pahtak-huai ahi hi.
Meigong taktak ahi, amah guak a omte in Pasian' tungah lametna koih uh a, sun tawh zan tawh thumna leh thungetna nei den uh hi.
A noptat numei ahihleh nungta kimlai mah a si ahi hi.
Tua hi a, tua mite kawkbaanglo ahih nadingun hih thute zong thupiakin na bawl in.
Ahi zongin mi khatpeuh in amah tawh kisaite, a diakin ama' innkuanpihte, a khoi a vak keileh upna a nial hi khinta a, thu-umlo mi sangin suksiazaw hi.
Meigong numei min malgualh sungah na guan dingte pen khankum sawmguk sangin a tawmzaw lo hiding a, pasal khat bek ii zi hiding hi.
Nahoih sepna tawh min hoih a ngah: tate a khansuah, zinleleng do a siam, mi siangthote' khe a silsak, a gentheite a huh a van, nahoih sep kici khempeuh a kin, hiding hi.
Ahih hangin meigong numei khangno laite ahihleh a min uh guang kei in. A hang pen cilesa lunggulhna tawh Khris nusia-in innkuan neikik nuam ding uh hi.
Tua huhau-in a kiciamna masa uh a peengsak suakin thukhenna thuak ding uh hi.
Tua banah inn khatkhit khat vak kawikawi-in thadah a kisinsin suak ding uh a, thadah bek hilo-in gen loh ding pi teng a gen, migensiate leh milak kihel supsupte suak ding uh hi.
Tua hangin eite hong mindaisak ding galpa in hunpha a ngah loh nadingin meigong khangno laite pasal neikikin ta nei-in amau' innkuan tek a makaih ding uh ka deih hi.
A hang pen mi kimkhatte lam pialin Satan' nung zui khinta uh hi.
Thu-um numei khatpeuh in a inn sungah meigong numei a neih leh tuate huh henla pawlpi vangik suan kei ta hen. Tua hileh pawlpi in a meigong taktakte huhin van thei ding hi.
Hoihtak hong makaih pawlpi makaite, a diakin Pasian' thu genkhiatna leh hilhcianna a hahkatte, thupibawlna a zah nih a ngahtaakte ci-in ciamteh un.
A hang pen Pasian' Laibu in, “Buhphal a cil bawng a muk tuam kei in,” ci a, “Nasemte in thaman a ngah ding uh kilawm hi,” zong ci hi.
Teci nihlethum tawh lahcianna a om leh cihloh pawlpi makai khat a kingawhna thu taksang kei in.
Mawhna bawlte ahihleh midangte zong a lau theih nadingun vekpi' mai-ah khialhna laktel in.
Sawimuhkholh nei lo-in hih thute na zuih nading leh deidanna na zat hetloh nadingin Pasian' mai, Khris Jesu' mai leh teeltuam vanmite' mai-ah khauhtak kong gen hi.
Khutngak vai ah nawhtat kei inla midangte' khialhna ah zong kihelkha kei in; nangmahmah a siangtho-in kikem in.
(Tui bek na dawn nawnkei inla na gilsung damlohna leh na cinat munna hangin lengtui zong tawm na zang in.)
Mi kimkhat a mawhnate uh muhbaihin tuate amau' ma-in thukhenna lamah na mapai uh a, kimkhatte ahihleh a mawhnate uh a nung uhah hong pai hi.
Tua mah bangin nahoih sepnate zong muhbaih a, a tuaci pah lote nangawn kiseelcipsuak thei tuanlo hi.
